title: The Cold Machine
author: Ulyana Eriksen
blurb: August Quintana, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
